message: I have a friend who panics at the first sign of a storm. The last time we had a little thunder rumble, she texted me asking if I thought she'd need a life raft. I chuckled and reminded her that a good flashlight and some snacks might be more helpful. It’s funny how a little preparation can turn a stormy day into just another cozy evening at home. Anyone else have a friend like that? 🌧️
